name: Southern Cross Network Cabling LLC
old_description: Our structured data cabling service specializes in copper network certification and efficient network cabling solutions that ensure optimal performance and reliability. Trust us to design and install a robust infrastructure that meets your business's connectivity needs.
about:
Southern Cross Network Cabling LLC operates from Golden, Colorado, where it was founded in 2000. The company was established with a mission to deliver reliable, exceptional service for network infrastructure needs.

The firm specializes in three core service lines: wireless access point installation, fiber optic solutions (including cabling, splicing, testing, and certification), and structured data cabling with copper network certification. Technicians design and install infrastructure for commercial and industrial clients across Colorado and the Western United States. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

The company serves a range of sectors including oil and gas, gaming, ski resorts, cellular, hospitality, new construction, and tenant improvement projects. These industry verticals are listed explicitly on its website.

Southern Cross emphasizes a customer‑first philosophy, stating that its track record is built on “doing whatever it takes to provide the customer service you expect and deserve.” The founder’s original mandate — service that can be counted on to deliver every time — remains the stated differentiator after more than two decades.
